item.title: Real estate PF court and public auctions reach 11 trillion won… “Even completed projects face growing risk of recovery due to sluggish sales and disposition” (부동산PF 경·공매 11조원…“완공 사업장도 분양·매각 부진 회수위험 커져”)
item.description:
Among the total real estate project financing (PF) exposure of 59 trillion won across all domestic financial sectors, distressed projects undergoing court and public auctions have reached 11 trillion won. Notably, recovery risks are increasing not only for unstarted and unfinished bridge loan projects, but also for recently completed main PF projects due to sluggish sales and disposition. (국내 전체 금융권의 부동산 프로젝트파이낸싱(PF·피에프) 익스포저(위험노출액) 59조원 가운데 경·공매가 추진중인 부실 사업장이 11조원에 이르는 것으로 나타났다. 특히 미착공·미준공 브릿지론 사업장뿐 아니라 최근에는 완공된 본피에프 사업장에도 분양·매각 부진으로 회수 리스크가 커지고 있다.)

According to Korea Credit Rating on the 13th, the PF balance (based on quarterly average balance) of projects undergoing court and public auctions in the second quarter stood at approximately 11.2 trillion won, up about 1.9 trillion won from the previous quarter. The quarterly average PF balance of projects in court and public auctions had declined for three consecutive quarters through the first quarter, but turned to an increase in the second quarter. Increases were observed across all regions, including Seoul (1 trillion won), Incheon and Gyeonggi (4.5 trillion won), and other regions (5.9 trillion won). Korea Credit Rating assessed that “the accumulation of projects in court and public auctions (expanding balances and stalled resolution), centered on officetels, large-scale other residential facilities, apartments, and logistics centers, is not limited to specific areas but is spreading across both the capital region and other regions nationwide.” (13일 한국신용평가에 따르면, 지난 2분기 경·공매 추진 사업장의 피에프 잔액(분기 평잔 기준)은 약 11조2천억원으로 전분기 대비 약 1조9천억원 증가했다. 경·공매 추진 사업장의 분기 평균 피에프 잔액은 지난 1분기까지 3개 분기 연속 감소했으나, 2분기에 증가세로 돌아섰다. 서울 1조원, 인천·경기 4조5천억원, 지방 5조9천억원 등 수도권을 포함한 전 지역에서 증가세를 보였다. 한신평은 “오피스텔, 대규모 기타주거시설, 아파트·물류센터 등을 중심으로 경·공매 추진 사업장의 적체 현상(잔액 확대 및 해소 정체)이 특정 지역에 국한되지 않고 수도권과 지방 전반으로 확산되고 있다”고 평가했다.)

In particular, among projects included in court and public auctions (including all stages: permits, commencement, construction progress, and completion), the share of main PF projects expanded from 16.8% in the first quarter to 23.6% as of the end of June. Korea Credit Rating projected that “while the main risk was previously tied to unstarted and unfinished bridge loan stages, the risk of main PF projects, whose recovery potential declines even after completion due to poor sales performance or delayed disposition, is increasingly coming to the fore. Considering the maturity of main PF loans and the prolonged sluggish sales performance, more main PF projects are expected to be incorporated into court and public auctions for the time being.” (특히 경·공매 추진에 편입된 사업장(인허가·착공·공사진행·완공 모두 포함) 중에 본피에프 사업장이 차지하는 비중이 지난 1분기 16.8%에서 6월 말 23.6%로 확대됐다. 한신평은 “기존에는 브릿지론 단계의 미착공·미준공 리스크가 주요 위험이었다면, 최근에는 완공 이후에도 분양성과 부진 또는 매각 지연으로 회수 가능성이 저하되는 본피에스 사업장의 리스크가 점차 부각되고 있다. 본피에프 만기도래와 분양성과 부진 장기화 흐름을 감안할 때 당분간 본피에프 사업장이 더 많이 경공매로 편입될 것으로 보인다”고 내다봤다.)

Amid the increase in distressed projects undergoing court and public auctions, uncertainty over the recovery of collateral value is also growing due to sluggish auction results. According to court auction data, the property auction sale rate (number of successful bids / number of auctions) and sale price-to-appraisal ratio (sale price / appraisal value) have been steadily declining since peaking in the second half of 2024 (sale rate 26.2%, sale price-to-appraisal ratio 72.3%). As of the end of May, the sale rate had fallen to 22.5% and the sale price-to-appraisal ratio to 58.2%. This indicates that resolving distressed projects through auctions is being delayed, and uncertainty over the recovery of collateral value is increasing. (경공매 추진 부실 사업장이 증가세를 보이는 가운데 경매 부진으로 담보가치 회수 불확실성도 커지고 있다. 법원경매정보 자료에 따르면, 부동산 경매 매각률(낙찰건수/경매건수)과 매각가율(매각가액/감정가액)이 2024년 하반기(매각률 26.2%, 매각가율 72.3%)를 정점으로 꾸준히 하락하고 있는데, 지난 5월 말 기준 매각률은 22.5%, 매각가율은 58.2%까지 하락했다. 경매를 통한 부실 사업장 해소가 지연되고 담보가치 회수 관련 불확실성이 높아지고 있는 것이다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Wonju Children and Social Welfare Meal Management Support Center Operates 'Silver-Cook Cooking Activity' for Seniors and Disabled Individuals (원주시어린이·사회복지급식관리지원센터, 어르신·장애인 대상 '실버-쿡 요리활동' 운영)
item.description:
<<> The Wonju Children and Social Welfare Meal Management Support Center (Director Lee Hae-young), operated under consignment by Sangji University, ran the 'Silver-Cook Cooking Activity'—a specialized project for social welfare meal services—over three days from the 7th to the 9th. <<> This project was organized for about 120 seniors and disabled individuals using social welfare facilities in Wonju. Nutritionists from the center directly visited a total of five institutions selected through first-come, first-served applications: two home-based senior welfare facilities, two senior medical welfare facilities, and one vocational rehabilitation facility for the disabled, carrying out the program and receiving high praise from users and facility staff. <<> In the 'Silver-Cook Cooking Activity,' participants made nostalgic sandwiches using Gijeongtteok (rice cake) made from Wonju's local specialties—potatoes and makgeolli (rice wine). The participants trimmed ingredients, completed the sandwiches, felt a sense of achievement, recalled childhood memories, and shared stories with each other, spending meaningful time together. <<> Director Lee Hae-young stated, "Through this specialized project, it was very meaningful to see participants recalling precious childhood memories and sharing joy while cooking together," adding, "We will continue to strive to support users' vibrant daily lives and healthy eating habits through various nutrition education and experiential programs in the future." <<>   <<> <<> <<>> ( )

item.title: Corporate Clients Cry Out Over Token Costs... AI Models Compete on ‘Cost-Effectiveness’ (기업 고객 토큰 비용 비명에…AI모델 ‘가성비’ 경쟁)
item.description:
Recently, generative artificial intelligence (AI) developers have been unveiling their latest models, touting not only performance but also cost efficiency as a key competitive edge. As corporate clients begin to seriously scrutinize the cost of using AI models, the competition, once centered on performance, is expanding to include token efficiency and expense. (최근 생성형 인공지능(AI) 개발사들이 자사 최신 모델을 선보이면서 성능 뿐 아니라 ‘비용 효율’을 핵심 경쟁력으로 내세우고 있다. 기업 고객들이 인공지능 모델 사용료 부담을 본격적으로 따지기 시작하면서 성능 중심이던 인공지능 모델 경쟁도 토큰 효율과 비용으로 넓어지는 모양새다.)

OpenAI, on the 9th (local time), unveiled its new AI model ‘GPT-5.6’, emphasizing from the very first line of its announcement that it offers “more intelligence per token, stronger performance per dollar.” The company, for the first time, released the model in three tiers—Sol, Terra, and Luna—based on performance levels. Regarding these models, OpenAI highlighted cost efficiency repeatedly, stating that Sol “sets a new standard for both intelligence and efficiency,” and that Terra and Luna “outperform or perform similarly to GPT-5.5 in knowledge work evaluations, while being significantly cheaper.” <<> On the same day, Facebook’s parent company Meta unveiled its next-generation model ‘Muse Spark 1.1’ and introduced its first paid pricing model for developers, setting input and output costs at $1.25 and $4.25 per million tokens, respectively. This is less than a quarter of the pricing for the GPT-5.6 Sol model ($5 input and $30 output per million tokens). SpaceX.AI, which released its new model ‘Grok 4.5’ a day earlier than Meta and OpenAI, also stated that Grok 4.5’s token efficiency is about twice that of the leading models from its competitors. <<> The growing efficiency competition among AI developers is driven by the rapidly increasing burden of token costs for companies. In the early stages of AI adoption, among U.S. Silicon Valley firms, there was a trend of ‘token maxing’, encouraging employees to use AI as much as possible and treating it as a productivity metric. However, after companies faced massive token usage bills, using tokens efficiently has emerged as a key task. Uber, which exhausted a year’s budget for AI coding tools in just four months following the introduction of Claude Code, has now implemented cost controls. Some U.S. companies, burdened by costs, have turned to Chinese AI models that prioritize cost-effectiveness. Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, said in a CNBC interview on the 9th, “This year is the first where AI costs have become a hot topic,” adding, “Everyone is asking what we can do to help them cut spending or increase value.” <<> Under pressure from cost competition, developers are working to improve model efficiency while also reducing costs through in-house chip development. As large-scale computation increases learning and inference costs, they are simultaneously developing their own inference chips to reduce reliance on external suppliers like Nvidia and improve cost structures. Reuters recently reported that Meta plans to begin mass production of its self-designed AI chip, ‘Iris’, starting in September this year. OpenAI unveiled a prototype of its own inference-specific semiconductor, co-developed with Broadcom, at the end of last month. <<> Reporter Kang Jae-gu j9@hani.co.kr (오픈에이아이(AI)는 9일(현지시각) 새 인공지능 모델 ‘지피티(GPT)-5.6’을 선보이면서 발표문 첫머리부터 “토큰마다 더 많은 지능, 달러당 더 강한 성능”을 가졌다고 강조했다. 회사는 이번에 처음으로 성능 수준에 따라 솔·테라·루나로 세부 모델을 나눠 출시했는데, 이들 모델을 두고서도 “지능과 효율성 모두 새로운 기준을 제시”(솔) 했다거나, 지식업무 평가에서 “지피티-5.5보다 각각 성능이 뛰어나거나 유사하면서 비용은 훨씬 저렴”(테라·루나)하다는 등 비용 효율성을 거듭 부각했다.)

item.title: Government Launches Development of ‘Free AI for All Citizens’…Set to Release Within the Year (정부, ‘대국민 무료 AI’ 개발 착수…연내 출시 목표)
item.description:
The ‘AI for Everyone Project,’ an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot service available to all citizens for free, will begin its beta service this September. (전 국민이 무료로 이용할 수 있는 인공지능(AI) 챗봇 서비스 ‘모두의 에이아이 프로젝트’가 오는 9월 베타 서비스를 시작한다.)

The Ministry of Science and ICT announced on the 13th that it has started accepting applications for the ‘AI for Everyone Project,’ a project to develop AI services for the public based on domestic AI models, including proprietary foundation models. The government plans to select a contractor in August after document and presentation evaluations, unveil a beta service at the end of September, and launch the official service within the year. (과학기술정보통신부는 13일 독자 파운데이션 모델 등 국산 인공지능 모델을 기반으로 한 대국민 인공지능 서비스 개발 사업인 ‘모두의 에이아이 프로젝트’ 공모를 시작했다고 밝혔다. 정부는 서류·발표 평가를 거쳐 8월 중 사업자를 선정하고, 9월 말 베타 서비스를 공개한 뒤 연내 정식 서비스를 출시할 계획이다.)

The AI for Everyone Project involves two to three private companies with experience in public services developing general-purpose AI services that reflect citizens’ needs and providing them without usage limits. Selected companies must utilize more than 50% of domestic models developed through a ‘from scratch’ approach (independently designed and learned from the ground up) and incorporate at least 30% of other domestic AI models into the service. (모두의 에이아이 프로젝트는 대국민 서비스 경험을 보유한 민간 기업 2∼3곳이 국민 수요를 반영한 범용 인공지능 서비스를 개발해 이용량 제한 없이 제공하는 사업이다. 선정 기업은 ‘프롬 스크래치’(처음부터 자체 설계·학습) 방식으로 개발된 국산 모델을 50% 이상 활용해야 하며, 다른 국내 인공지능 모델도 30% 이상 결합해 서비스를 개발해야 한다.)

According to the Ministry of Science and ICT, while the number of generative AI users in South Korea reaches 23 million, one-third of the population has limited access. Additionally, most users rely on free versions of foreign AI services, and concerns have been raised that changes in pricing policies could restrict usage in the future. (과기정통부에 따르면, 생성형 에이아이 국내 이용자는 2300만명에 이르지만, 국민의 3분의 1은 접근이 제한되는 실정이다. 또 이용자 대부분이 외국의 에이아이 무료 버전을 사용하고 있는데, 향후 가격 정책 변경에 따라 사용에 제약이 있을 수 있다는 우려가 제기돼 왔다.)

To support rapid service development, the government plans to allocate 128 or 256 of its latest NVIDIA B200 graphics processing units (GPUs) per company, based on evaluation rankings. It also intends to cover service operation costs from next year until the end of 2030 with government budget. However, the use of foreign models, limited to certain auxiliary functions, will be excluded from government support. (정부는 신속한 서비스 개발을 지원하기 위해 보유 중인 엔비디아 최신 그래픽처리장치(GPU) B200을 평가 순위에 따라 기업당 128장 또는 256장씩 배분한다. 또 내년부터 2030년 말까지 서비스 운영에 필요한 비용을 정부 예산으로 지원할 계획이다. 다만, 일부 보조 기능에 한해 제한적으로 사용할 수 있는 외산 모델 활용분은 정부 지원 대상에서 제외된다.)

Furthermore, the service will include a ‘public AI secretary.’ It will provide features that recommend public services needed by citizens in a customized manner and support the application process. Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT, Bae Kyung-hoon, stated, “AI for Everyone is a platform that ensures everyone can benefit in the new economic structure spurred by AI.” (아울러 해당 서비스에는 ‘공공 인공지능 비서’도 탑재된다. 국민에게 필요한 공공 서비스를 맞춤형으로 추천하고, 신청 절차까지 지원하는 기능이 제공될 예정이다. 배경훈 부총리 겸 과기정통부 장관은 “모두의 에이아이는 에이아이가 촉발할 새로운 경제 구조 속에서 모두가 혜택을 누릴 수 있게 뒷받침하는 플랫폼”이라고 말했다.)

By Sun Dam-eun, Reporter sun@hani.co.kr (선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Hong-geun: "Next Year's Budget 800 Trillion Won + α... More Than 10% Increase Over This Year" (박홍근 “내년 예산 800조+α…올해보다 10% 이상 증가”)
item.description:
Next year's total expenditure is expected to exceed 800 trillion won, expanding by more than 10% compared to this year's original budget. This marks the first time since 2009 (10.6%) that the total expenditure growth rate based on the original budget has exceeded 10%. Unlike then, when fiscal spending was expanded in response to the global financial crisis, this time it reflects a determination to play an "active fiscal role" during a period of major industrial transformation, based on a tax revenue boom driven by the semiconductor super-cycle. (내년도 총지출 규모가 올해 본예산보다 10% 이상 확대된 800조원을 넘길 전망이다. 본예산 기준 총지출 증가율이 10%를 넘기는 건 2009년(10.6%) 이후 처음이다. 당시 글로벌 금융위기 대응을 위해 재정 지출을 확대했던 것과 달리, 이번엔 반도체 슈퍼사이클(초호황)에 따른 세수 호황을 바탕으로 산업 대전환기에 ‘재정의 적극적 역할’을 하겠다는 의지가 담겨있다.)

On the 13th, Minister of Planning and Budget Park Hong-geun announced at the "2026 National Fiscal Strategy Meeting" chaired by President Lee Jae-myung at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guesthouse, "We will set next year's total expenditure at 800 trillion won + α, an increase of more than 10% over this year's original budget." This year's original budget, the first compiled under the Lee Jae-myung administration, was 727.9 trillion won, an 8.1% increase from the previous year, signaling an active fiscal stance. Including the supplementary budget, total expenditure stands at 753 trillion won. (박홍근 기획예산처 장관은 13일 청와대 영빈관에서 이재명 대통령 주재로 열린 ‘2026년 국가재정전략회의’에서 “내년도 총지출을 올해 본예산보다 10% 이상 늘린 800조원+α 규모로 편성하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이재명 정부가 들어선 뒤 첫 편성했던 올해 본예산은 727조9천억원으로, 전년 대비 8.1% 늘어나 적극 재정의 신호탄을 알린 바 있다. 추가경정예산(추경)을 합친 총지출은 753조원이다.)

Minister Park projected that next year's national tax revenue will reach at least 500 trillion won. This is 88 trillion won higher than the next year's national tax revenue forecast (412.1 trillion won) under the medium-term fiscal outlook (2025-2029). It is also more than 100 trillion won above this year's original budget-based national tax revenue (390.2 trillion won). The plan is to deposit tax revenue growth exceeding the long-term trend into the Future Response Fund and allocate it to four key priority areas: support for the younger generation, expanding future growth engines, local investment, and talent development. (박 장관은 내년 국세수입은 500조원 이상이 될 것으로 전망했다. 중기재정전망(2025~2029년)상 예상했던 내년 국세수입 전망치(412조1천억원) 대비 88조원을 웃도는 규모다. 올해 본예산 기준 국세수입(390조2천억원)보다 100조원 이상 많다. 장기 추세를 웃도는 세수 증가분은 미래대응기금에 적립해 청년세대 지원, 미래 성장동력 확충, 지방 투자, 인재 육성 등 4대 중점 분야에 투입한다는 방침이다.)

Park Soo-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Leverage Reflection’ Cry from FSS Chief, Yet Before Asset Managers, Only a Feeble ‘Don’t Exaggerate Ads’ (‘레버리지 반성’ 외치던 금감원장, 운용사 앞에선 고작 “과장광고 말라”)
item.description:
Since 16 single-stock leverage products on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix were listed, they have caused severe KOSPI volatility over the past month and a half, with the tail wagging the dog. While the market is voicing responsibility for the launch of these leverage products, the Presidential Policy Office, the Financial Services Commission, and the Financial Supervisory Service, which pushed for their introduction at the time, have failed to come up with proper measures, merely repeating that they are ‘looking into it.’ The FSS chief, who had earlier lamented that he ‘should have blocked them even by lying down,’ abruptly convened asset management firm CEOs and scolded them to ‘avoid exaggerated advertising.’ <<> FSS Governor Lee Chan-jin held a meeting with CEOs of 20 asset management firms at the Korea Financial Investment Association in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 13th, stating, “Since investors primarily rely on asset managers’ advertisements when selecting ETFs (Exchange Traded Funds), false or exaggerated advertising by asset managers is a very serious issue for investor protection,” and added, “Extraordinary self-regulatory efforts are needed to prevent market order disruptions, such as exaggerated advertising.” He further noted, “It is very regrettable that cases of exaggerated advertising have frequently occurred at large asset management firms,” and urged them to “ensure thorough management of price discrepancies, along with liquidity provider (LP) securities firms, in the ETF management process.” <<> Previously, on the 8th of last month, the ‘ACE SK Hynix Single Stock Leverage’ product by Korea Investment Trust Management saw a severe price discrepancy. Despite the underlying asset, SK Hynix shares, dropping nearly 8%, the price surged nearly 50% from the previous close due to a sudden spike in quotes just before the market close, when liquidity providers are not obligated to submit bids. <<> The domestic stock market is experiencing extreme daily volatility, fueled by the concentration on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, amplified by leverage products on these stocks. The total net asset value of domestically listed ETFs (1,140 items) surged from 297.1 trillion won last year to 532.6 trillion won as of June 22. On the 10th, the trading volume of these two single-stock leverage products reached 10.1157 trillion won, accounting for 31.6% of the total daily ETF trading volume (31.9757 trillion won). As of the 13th, all single-stock leverage products on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix had entered loss territory. <<> Governor Lee, who said at a press conference on June 22, “I regret that I should have blocked them even by lying down,” made no specific mention of single-stock leverage products at the meeting on this day. Amid calls from both inside and outside the market for delisting single-stock leverage products, voices are growing for urgent supplementary measures, such as raising the minimum deposit requirement and restricting investment proportions by investor type. <<> Senior Correspondent Cho Kye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 16개 종목이 상장된 뒤 한 달 보름 동안 ‘꼬리가 몸통을 흔들며’ 극심한 코스피 변동성을 연출하고 있다. 레버리지 상품 출시에 대한 책임론이 시장에서 분출하고 있으나, 당시 이를 밀어붙인 청와대 정책실·금융위원회·금융감독원은 마땅한 대책을 내놓지 못한 채 “살펴보고 있다”는 말만 되풀이하고 있다. “드러누워서라도 막았어야 했다”고 자책했던 금감원장은 갑자기 자산운용사 대표들을 불러모아 “과장광고를 하지 말라”고 을렀다.)

item.title: KOSPI Breaks 7,000 Mark in Two Months... Samsung Electronics Plunges 10%, SK Hynix Drops 15% (코스피, 두 달 만에 7000선 깨져…‘삼전’ 10% ‘닉스’ 15% 급락)
item.description:
The KOSPI plummeted over 8% on the 13th, breaking below 7,000 for the first time in about two months. SK Hynix celebrated its Nasdaq listing last weekend, but the stock fell below 2 million won as concerns over a peak in the semiconductor cycle persisted. (코스피가 13일 8% 넘게 급락해 약 두달 만에 7000이 깨졌다. 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 지난 주말 나스닥 상장 축포를 터트렸지만 반도체 고점 우려를 해소하지 못하고 200만원 아래로 떨어졌다.)

On this day, the KOSPI index closed at 6,806.93, down 669.01 points (8.95%) from the previous trading session. It briefly dropped to the 6,700 range during the day. This marks the first time the KOSPI has fallen below the 7,000 mark since it surpassed that level on May 6, about two months ago. (이날 코스피지수는 전 거래일보다 669.01(8.95%) 떨어진 6806.93에 장을 마감했다. 장중 한때 6700대로 떨어지기도 했다. 코스피가 5월6일 7000선을 넘어선 뒤 이를 밑돈 것은 두 달여 만이다.)

As the KOSPI plunged over 8%, a circuit breaker was triggered at 1:28 PM, suspending trading for 20 minutes. This is the seventh circuit breaker activation in the securities market this year and the 13th in history. (코스피가 8% 넘게 급락하자 오후 1시28분 서킷브레이커가 발동돼 매매가 20분간 중단됐다. 올해 들어 유가증권 시장에서 7번째 서킷브레이커 발동이고, 역대로는 13번째다.)

The sharp drop in the index was driven by a slump in the two major semiconductor stocks. Samsung Electronics plunged 10.70%, falling to 254,000 won. SK Hynix, which listed on Nasdaq through American depositary receipts on the 10th (local time), saw its shares surge 10% on its first day of trading, but the domestic stock plummeted 15.37% on this day, dropping to 1,845,000 won. Analysts attribute this to profit-taking as the excitement over the US listing event faded and concerns about a peak in memory semiconductor prices lingered. Additionally, volatility amplified by leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix also contributed to the decline. (이날 지수 폭락은 반도체 양대 축의 주가 급락에서 비롯됐다. 삼성전자가 10.70% 급락해 25만4000원으로 주저앉았다. 지난 10일(현지시각) 미국주식예탁증서 상장을 통해 나스닥에 입성한 에스케이하이닉스는 상장 첫날 10% 급등해 흥행했지만, 정작 이날 국내 시장에서 본주는 15.37% 폭락해 184만5000원으로 주저앉았다. 그동안 주가를 밀어올리던 미국 증시 상장 이벤트가 끝나고 메모리반도체 고점 우려가 여전하면서 차익실현 매물이 쏟아진 것으로 풀이된다. 여기에 삼성전자·에스케이하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드로 인한 변동성 증폭도 함 원인으로 증권가는 해석한다.)

Escalating tensions between the US and Israel-Iran also appear to have had an impact. Foreign investors, who had briefly turned net buyers on the 8th and 9th, sold a net 1.7 trillion won on the 10th and continued their selling spree for a second day. (미국·이스라엘-이란 긴장 고조도 영향을 끼친 것으로 보인다. 지난 8~9일 잠깐 순매수로 돌아섰던 외국인은 10일에 이어 이날도 1조7천억원 순매도하며 이틀째 매도세를 이어갔다.)

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: SK Hynix Nasdaq Listing Brings ‘Semiconductor Green Light,’ But KOSPI Plunges – Why? (SK하이닉스 나스닥 상장 ‘반도체 청신호’에도 코스피 급락, 왜?)
item.description:
Despite expectations that SK Hynix’s successful listing on the Nasdaq on the 10th (local time) via American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) would restore investor sentiment in the domestic semiconductor sector, the KOSPI plummeted on the 13th. Analysts attribute this to lingering concerns over a semiconductor supercycle not being dispelled, and the fact that the ADR listing effectively removed a positive catalyst for the sector. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 지난 10일(현지시각) 미국 주식예탁증서(ADR·에이디알) 상장을 통해 나스닥 시장에 성공적으로 입성하며 국내 증시의 반도체 업종 투자심리도 회복될 것이란 기대와 달리 코스피는 13일 급락했다. 반도체 초호황(슈퍼사이클) 우려가 해소되지 못한 상황에서 오히려 에이디알로 인한 반도체 업종 호재가 사라진 영향 등으로 분석된다.)

On that day, SK Hynix closed at 1,845,000 won, down 15.37% from the previous trading day. The closing price fell below the “2 million won mark” for the first time in about a month since the 8th of last month (1,911,000 won). Just two weeks ago, on the 25th of last month, the stock had soared to an intraday high of 2,987,000 won, only to crash by over 1 million won. Samsung Electronics, another major semiconductor stock, also struggled, closing at 254,500 won, down 10.70% on the day. <<> Both stocks have recently weakened due to deteriorating global memory semiconductor industry outlooks. However, when SK Hynix’s ADR closed at $168.01 on its first day, 12.8% above the offering price, a successful debut sparked hopes over the weekend that the semiconductor supercycle outlook remains intact and that the domestic stock market, led by the semiconductor sector, would benefit. Yet on Monday, domestic investors, viewing the ADR listing as a completed positive event, rushed to lock in profits. Samsung Securities, in an emergency domestic market report, analyzed that “TSMC’s ADR trades at about a 15% premium over its underlying stock. As the market recognized this was in line with expectations, profit-taking selling emerged.” <<> Furthermore, the persistently high premium of SK Hynix’s ADR over its underlying stock is seen as failing to stem selling by foreign investors. It is known that foreign investment banks have recently advised investors to buy SK Hynix’s ADR and sell the underlying stock due to the high premium. Foreign investors net sold 1.7 trillion won worth of SK Hynix on that day, and have disposed of a total of 6.6 trillion won so far this month. While there are expectations that the ADR premium could lead to a revaluation of the underlying stock, Kim Doo-un, an analyst at Hana Securities, noted, “Looking at POSCO Holdings and LG Display, it’s hard to say that the premium drove up the underlying stock price.” <<> Additionally, the success of SK Hynix’s ADR listing appears insufficient to dispel doubts about the global semiconductor supercycle outlook. Heo Jae-hwan, an analyst at Eugene Investment & Securities, pointed out that “concerns exist that domestic corporate profit expectations, including semiconductors, may soon peak, or that the current pace of profit growth cannot be sustained.” Reports from securities firms suggesting that SK Hynix’s second-quarter earnings may fall short of consensus are also seen as fueling selling sentiment. Analysts Chae Min-sook and Kim Yeon-joon of Korea Investment & Securities noted that this is “because SK Hynix has a higher revenue share from HBM compared to competitors, resulting in a lower ASP growth rate than the market average.” <<> The key going forward will be whether mutual conversion between the underlying stock and ADR is possible. Kim Min-kyu, an analyst at KB Securities, predicted that “the easier the conversion between ADR and underlying stock, the more fully the valuation expansion effect can transfer to the underlying stock.” Whether the ADR will be included in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) could also act as a positive catalyst. Above all, attention is focused on the capital expenditure (CAPEX) plans of major US “big tech” companies, expected to be announced at the end of this month. Yang Hyung-mo, an analyst at DS Investment & Securities, advised that “since last month, the market has been transitioning from a phase of pricing based on unconditional growth to re-evaluating capital efficiency and cash flow,” recommending a conservative stance rather than hasty bottom-fishing. <<> Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr ( 이날 에스케이하이닉스는 전 거래일보다 15.37% 떨어진 184만5000원에 거래를 마쳤다. 종가 기준 ‘200만 닉스’가 깨진 것은 지난달 8일(191만1000원) 이후 한달여 만이다. 불과 보름 전인 지난달 25일까지만 해도 장중 298만7000원까지도 치솟았던 주가가 100만원 넘게 폭락한 것이다. 반도체 대형주인 삼성전자도 이날 10.70% 급락한 25만4500원에 거래를 마치며 부진을 면치 못했다.)

item.title: Hanwha Ocean's vanguard-penetration 'spearhead formation' bidding tactic… can it break through the Thai frigate project? (한화오션의 전방 돌파형 ‘첨자진’ 수주 전술…타이 호위함 사업 뚫을까)
item.description:
After failing to overcome the 'Atlantic Alliance' wave in Canada's submarine patrol project and suffering a bitter defeat to a German defense company, Hanwha Ocean is now seeking to restore its honor in the Thai Navy frigate bidding war, facing off against Turkish companies and others. (캐나다 초계 잠수함 사업에서 ‘대서양 동맹’의 파도를 넘지 못하고 독일 방산기업에 쓰라린 패배를 당했던 한화오션이 타이 해군 호위함 사업 수주전에서 튀르키예 업체 등을 상대로 명예회복에 나선다.)

According to the shipbuilding and defense industry on the 13th, the Thai Navy, which is pushing to procure one 4,000-ton next-generation frigate, is expected to announce the contractor selection results soon. Six companies participated in the bidding that closed in April. From South Korea, Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries submitted proposals, while Turkey—a NATO ally rising as a defense powerhouse alongside Germany—had two bidders, Asfat and Tais. Spanish and Singaporean companies also joined the bid. Local Thai media have reported that the Thai Navy is making a final comparison between Hanwha Ocean and Turkish companies. There have even been rumors in Thai political circles about a 'pre-selection of a South Korean company,' leading to speculation that the final announcement timeline may be somewhat fluid. <<> Although the project is valued at 800 billion won, not a large scale, Southeast Asia, which is ramping up its naval power, remains a crucial export market for South Korean defense companies where they have been actively rowing. A defense industry official said, "While not matching China's overwhelming naval force, countries involved in South China Sea disputes and their neighbors are importing ships and submarines for security reasons." Another official noted, "Korean-made ships, which combine delivery timelines, technological capability, and cost competitiveness, are preferred." Although facing budget issues, the Thai Navy has also set a goal of building three more follow-on ships, which would expand the project's scale to around 3 trillion won. <<> Hanwha Ocean, considered the frontrunner in this bidding war, employs what can be likened to an ancient tactic: a vanguard-penetration 'spearhead formation.' It leverages the trust built since delivering a state-of-the-art frigate to the Thai Navy in 2018, when it was still Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering. The Thai Navy even named that warship 'Phumiphon Adunyadet' after the previous king, who reigned for 70 years and is revered as a national father, using it as the navy's flagship. A defense industry official said, "Thailand holds the royal family in very high esteem. It is expected to prioritize continuity in warship construction." When a Thai Navy delegation visited Hanwha Ocean's Geoje shipyard last June at the invitation of the South Korean Navy, Hanwha expressed its commitment to the next frigate project and proposed cooperation measures such as technology transfer, collaboration with local companies, and workforce training. Hanwha Ocean is known to have proposed the 4,000-ton frigate (OCEAN-40F), a model tailored for the Thai Navy. Aligned with the Thai Navy's preference for European weapons systems, the ship incorporates partnerships with European defense companies for radar, combat systems, missiles, and weapon integration solutions. It features a stealth hull design and a drone countermeasure system. <<> HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, which has relative strengths in surface ships, adopts a 'crane wing formation' encompassing neighboring countries. Since 2016, it has participated in the Philippine Navy's modernization project, securing orders for 12 ships including frigates and offshore patrol vessels. Five of these were delivered ahead of schedule, earning high praise. The export frigate (HDF-4000TH) proposed to the Thai Navy is a state-of-the-art platform developed based on the 3,000-ton model exported to Peru, tailored to the Thai Navy's requirements. It reportedly features a stealth hull design, a 360-degree multi-target tracking four-face fixed radar, and a drone countermeasure combat system. <<> The Thai Navy set bidding conditions requiring at least 20% of parts to be locally produced and technology transfer. For this project, no 'One Team' was formed under the Defense Acquisition Program Administration's coordination. A defense industry insider noted, "The ordering country specifically named the two companies to bid. With the project's scale being small, unlike Canada's submarine project worth up to 60 trillion won, there was no reason to form a One Team." <<> Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr ( 13일 조선·방산업계에 따르면, 4000톤급 차세대 호위함 1척을 도입하는 사업을 추진하는 타이 해군이 조만간 사업자 선정 결과를 발표한다. 지난 4월 마감한 입찰에 6개 업체가 참여했다. 한국에서는 한화오션과 에이치디(HD)현대중공업이 제안서를 냈고, 독일과 함께 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 동맹국으로 방산 강국으로 부상 중인 튀르키예의 아스파트·타이스 두 곳이 입찰했다. 스페인과 싱가포르 업체도 입찰에 응했다. 타이 현지 매체 등은 한화오션과 튀르키예 업체를 두고 타이 해군이 마지막 저울질을 하고 있다는 보도를 내놓고 있다. 타이 정치권에서 ‘한국 업체 내정설’이 불거지기도 해, 최종 발표 시기는 다소 유동적이라는 전망도 나온다.)

item.title: Government Support for Petrochemical Restructuring…울산 Industrial Complex Faces Complex Calculus Amid Performance Rebound and ‘Shaheen’ Variable (석화 재편 정부 지원에도…울산 산단, 실적 반등·‘샤힌’ 변수 맞물려 셈법 복잡)
item.description:
Although the government is establishing technical criteria to support companies participating in the restructuring of the petrochemical industry, the key hub, the Ulsan Industrial Complex, has yet to submit a specific business reorganization plan. This is due to a weakened incentive for production capacity reduction driven by a performance rebound, combined with variables in the operation of a large new facility that S-Oil is building in Ulsan. As the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) views the technology applied to this facility as a core strategic technology that could serve as a criterion for government support, the calculus surrounding the Ulsan Industrial Complex's business reorganization has become even more complicated. (정부가 석유화학산업 구조개편 참여 기업을 지원하기 위한 기술 기준을 마련하고 있지만, 정작 핵심 거점인 울산산단은 구체적인 사업재편안을 제출하지 못하고 있다. 실적 반등으로 생산능력 감축 유인이 약해진 데다, 에쓰오일이 울산에 짓는 대형 신규 설비의 가동 변수까지 맞물리면서다. 산업통상부가 이 설비에 적용된 기술도 정부 지원 기준이 될 핵심전략기술로 보고 있는 가운데, 울산산단의 사업재편을 둘러싼 셈법은 한층 복잡해졌다.)

Petrochemical restructuring involves reducing general-purpose petrochemical facilities mired in oversupply and transforming the industry's structure toward high-value-added and eco-friendly products. Through a voluntary agreement in August last year, the government and industry decided to cut production capacity of naphtha cracking centers (NCCs—facilities producing basic petrochemical raw materials) at the country's three major petrochemical complexes—Daesan, Yeosu, and Ulsan—by up to 3.7 million tons per year in ethylene equivalent and push for a shift to high-value-added product production. The government agreed to provide financial, tax, and R&D support to companies undertaking self-rescue efforts, and some companies at the Daesan and Yeosu complexes have already entered the business reorganization process. (석유화학 구조개편은 공급과잉에 빠진 범용 석유화학 설비를 줄이고 고부가·친환경 제품으로 산업 체질을 바꾸는 작업이다. 정부와 업계는 지난해 8월 자율협약을 통해 국내 3대 석유화학단지인 대산·여수·울산산단에서 나프타분해시설(NCC·석유화학 제품의 기초 원료를 만드는 설비) 생산능력을 에틸렌 기준 최대 연 370만톤 줄이고, 고부가가치 제품 생산으로 전환을 추진하기로 했다. 정부는 자구노력에 나선 기업에 금융·세제·연구개발 지원 등을 제공하기로 했고, 대산·여수산단의 일부 기업이 먼저 사업재편 절차에 들어갔다.)

The government is specifying the technical criteria for supporting companies that have undertaken self-rescue efforts. The 'Notification of Core Strategic Technologies for Petrochemicals' draft, which MOTIE pre-announced on the 2nd, sets the standards for what technologies the government will consider as core technologies needed for high-value-added and eco-friendly transition. The notification draft includes 12 technology items, such as high-functionality chemical materials for semiconductors, bio/recycling-based raw material conversion, and refinery-petrochemical process integration. (정부는 자구노력에 나선 기업에 대한 지원 기술 기준을 구체화하고 있다. 산업부가 지난 2일 행정예고한 ‘석유화학 핵심전략기술 고시’ 제정안은 정부가 앞으로 어떤 기술을 고부가·친환경 전환에 필요한 핵심기술로 볼지를 정하는 기준이다. 고시안에는 반도체용 고기능성 화학소재, 바이오·재활용 기반 원료전환, 정유·석유화학 공정 통합 등 12개 기술 항목이 담겼다.)

However, discussions and implementation of business reorganization at the site are progressing slowly. An industry rebound is cited as one of the variables. This is because if performance temporarily improves, companies or creditor groups may have a weaker incentive to hasten facility reduction or integration. According to an analysis by NICE Credit Evaluation, the combined operating profit margin of major petrochemical companies in the first quarter of this year rose to about 3%, the best level since 2022, and the trend of profitability improvement continued through April and May. (그러나 현장의 사업재편 논의와 이행은 더디게 진행되고 있다. 업황 반등이 변수 중 하나로 꼽힌다. 실적이 일시적으로 개선되면 기업이나 채권단이 설비 감축·통합을 서두를 유인이 약해질 수 있기 때문이다. 나이스신용평가 분석을 보면, 주요 석유화학사의 올해 1분기 합산 영업이익률은 약 3%로 올라 2022년 이후 가장 양호한 수준을 보였고, 4~5월에도 수익성 개선세가 이어졌다.)

In particular, the Ulsan Industrial Complex faces an additional variable: S-Oil's 'Shaheen Project.' Shaheen is a large-scale petrochemical investment project in which S-Oil is building an ethylene-based steam cracker with an annual capacity of 1.8 million tons at the Ulsan Complex, inevitably intertwining with restructuring discussions aimed at reducing NCC production capacity. Since companies within the Ulsan Complex are also negotiating while considering the operation status of Shaheen, slated to complete trial runs by the end of this year, the Ulsan Complex's final business reorganization plan is likely to take shape only next year. (특히 울산산단에는 에쓰오일의 ‘샤힌 프로젝트’라는 변수까지 더해진 상황이다. 샤힌은 에쓰오일이 울산산단에 에틸렌 기준 연 180만톤급 스팀크래커 등을 짓는 대형 석유화학 투자 사업으로, 나프타분해시설 생산능력 감축을 추진하는 구조개편 논의와 맞물릴 수밖에 없다. 울산산단 내 기업들도 올해 말 시운전 완료가 예정된 샤힌 가동 상황을 고려해 협의 중인 만큼, 울산산단의 최종 사업재편안은 내년에야 구체화될 가능성이 크다.)

While the Daesan and Yeosu restructuring plans previously revealed the outline of facility reductions, the Ulsan restructuring is expected to place greater emphasis on which technology will serve as the axis for high-value-added transition. This is because the technology applied to Shaheen falls within the scope of the government's currently pre-announced core strategic technology notification draft. A MOTIE official stated, "Shaheen's technology corresponds to 'refinery-petrochemical process integration technology' in the 'industrial advancement' section, the 12th item of the notification draft." He added, "The operation of Shaheen itself does not immediately mean 'participation in business reorganization,' but if efforts for high-value-added transition, such as additional technology development, are made, it could become subject to support consideration. It is not necessarily the view that S-Oil must unconditionally cut production to participate in business reorganization." A senior government official also said, "The basis of restructuring is not about reducing but about improving efficiency," adding, "Facilities with low competitiveness should be phased out, but we must compete with China through advancement." (앞서 대산·여수 재편안에서는 설비 감축의 윤곽이 먼저 드러난 반면, 울산 구조개편은 어떤 기술을 고부가 전환의 축으로 삼을지에 무게중심이 더 크게 실릴 것으로 보인다. 샤힌에 적용된 기술이 현재 행정예고 중인 정부의 핵심전략기술 고시안 범주에 들어갔기 때문이다. 산업부 관계자는 “샤힌의 기술은 고시안의 12번째 항목인 ‘산업 고도화’ 부문의 ‘정유·석화 공정 통합 기술’에 해당한다”고 말했다. 이어 “샤힌 가동 자체가 곧바로 ‘사업재편 참여’를 뜻하는 것은 아니지만, 추가 기술개발 등 고부가 전환 노력이 이뤄진다면 지원 검토 대상이 될 수 있다. 에쓰오일이 무조건 감산을 해야 사업재편에 참여한다고 보는 것은 아니다”라고 덧붙였다. 정부 고위 관계자도 “구조개편의 기본은 줄이는 것보다 효율(을 높이는 것)”이라며 “경쟁력이 떨어지는 설비는 정리하되, 고도화를 통해 중국과 경쟁해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Ha-young yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Homeplus blocks entrance with carts… Employees say they were notified of store closure after arriving for work (카트로 출입구 막은 홈플러스…직원들 “출근 뒤 휴업 통보 받아”)
item.description:
Customers turned away upon seeing "Temporary Closure" notices. The screens for both manned and unmanned checkout counters were all on, but the entrance was blocked by shopping carts, preventing entry. One citizen expressed disappointment, saying, "I knew food sales had stopped, but I came hoping to buy essential items like scissors or knives." Around 11 a.m. on the 13th, at the Homeplus Gangseo branch in Seoul, a stream of citizens visited the store that had closed without prior notice. (이용객들은 ‘임시 휴업’ 안내문을 맞닥뜨리고 발길을 돌렸다. 유인·무인 계산대 화면은 모두 켜져 있었으나, 출입구가 카트로 막혀 안으로 들어갈 수 없었다. 한 시민은 “식료품 판매가 중단된 것은 알고 있었지만, 가위나 칼 같은 생필품이라도 살 수 있을까 싶어 방문했다”며 허탈해했다. 13일 오전 11시께 서울 홈플러스 강서점에는 사전 안내 없이 문을 닫은 매장을 찾은 시민들의 발걸음이 이어졌다.)

Homeplus abruptly announced its closure on this day. Around 10 a.m., Homeplus stated, "Due to a depletion of operating funds and difficulties in maintaining and managing facilities, we are entering a temporary closure of large supermarkets starting today." However, even by the afternoon of that day, dozens of stores were still marked as "Open for Business" on the official Homeplus website, adding to public confusion. (홈플러스는 이날 갑작스럽게 휴업을 발표했다. 이날 오전 10시께 홈플러스는 “운영자금 고갈과 시설 유지·관리의 어려움으로 당일부터 대형마트 임시 휴업에 돌입한다”고 밝혔다. 그러나 이날 오후까지도 홈플러스 공식 누리집에는 매장 수십개가 여전히 ‘영업 중’으로 표시돼 시민들의 혼란을 부추겼다.)

It was reported that the closure was not pre-announced, leaving even on-site employees only aware after they had reported to work. Inside the Gangseo branch, a few employees were organizing remaining items, and outside, at the customer service center, uniformed staff were busy informing visiting customers of the store's closure. Ahn Soo-yong, head of the Homeplus branch of the Mart Industry Union under the Korean Federation of Service Workers' Unions, said, "All employees had completed their arrivals at work and were notified of the closure around 9:50 a.m. The method of notification varied by store—some used announcements or verbal communication from store managers, and some stores lowered the shutters first before informing employees." (휴업이 사전에 고지되지 않아 현장 직원들도 출근한 뒤에야 사실을 파악한 것으로 알려졌다. 강서점 매장 내부에서는 직원 몇명이 남은 물품을 정리하고 있었고, 매장 밖 고객서비스센터에서는 유니폼을 입은 직원들이 현장을 찾은 손님들에게 휴업 사실을 안내하느라 분주한 모습이었다. 안수용 민주노총 서비스연맹 마트산업노조 홈플러스지부장은 “직원들이 모두 출근을 완료한 상태에서 오전 9시50분께 휴업 사실을 통보받았다”며 “매장별로 안내 방송이나 점장의 구두 전달 등 전파 방식이 제각각이었고, 일부 매장은 안내 셔터를 먼저 내린 뒤 직원들에게 통보하기도 했다”고 전했다.)

Tenant businesses were also thrown into confusion. Homeplus explained that "tenant businesses can continue operations if the store owners wish," but it was difficult to expect customer traffic with the main store—the mart—being closed. Mr. A, an employee of a tenant business at the Yeongdeungpo branch, expressed dismay, saying, "We also found out about the temporary closure of the mart only this morning through the news, and we haven't received any instructions from headquarters on how to operate this store, so we're confused." Mr. B, an employee in his 60s working at a sports apparel rental store on the first floor of the Yeongdeungpo branch, said, "I worked at another Homeplus in Seoul for over 20 years, transferred here after that store closed last year, and now if all Homeplus stores nationwide close, partner companies don't know when or how much to reduce staff, so I feel anxious. It feels unfair that the country has left this situation to reach this point." (입점 업체들 역시 혼란에 빠졌다. 홈플러스 쪽은 “입점 업체는 점주들이 원하는 경우 영업을 지속할 수 있다”고 설명했으나, 주 매장인 마트가 폐쇄된 상황에서 고객 발걸음을 기대하기 어렵기 때문이다. 홈플러스 영등포점 입점 업체 직원 ㄱ씨는 “우리도 오늘 오전에야 뉴스를 보고 마트 임시 휴업 사실을 알았고 이곳 매장 운영을 어떻게 할지 본사에서 전달받은 게 없어 혼란스럽다”고 했다. 영등포점 1층 스포츠 의류 임대 매장에서 일하던 입점 업체 직원 ㄴ(60대)씨는 “서울 시내 다른 홈플러스에서 20년 넘게 근무하다가 지난해 점포가 문을 닫으면서 일하는 곳을 옮긴 건데, 전국 홈플러스가 문을 다 닫으면 협력 업체들도 인력을 언제, 얼마나 줄일지 몰라 불안하다”며 “상황이 이 지경이 되도록 방치한 나라가 야속하게 느껴진다”고 했다.)

Suppliers who lost their distribution channel were forced to immediately handle their remaining inventory. At a temporary salted seafood sales stand outside the entrance of the Yeongdeungpo branch, a supplier employee called out, "I'll give you an additional 3,000 won off the discount price!" to attract customers. He added, "I've been supplying goods to this store for nearly 12 years, and suddenly a major sales channel has been blocked overnight." (유통처가 사라진 납품업체들은 당장 재고를 처리해야 하는 상황에 내몰렸다. 영등포점 입구 바깥쪽에 임시로 마련된 젓갈 판매대에서는 납품업체 직원이 “할인가에서 3천원 더 할인해드린다”고 외치며 손님들의 발길을 붙잡았다. 그는 “이 매장에 12년 가까이 물건을 납품해왔는데 하루아침에 큰 판로가 막히게 됐다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the announcement of the closure on this day, Homeplus stated that it was "because operating funds have been completely exhausted, making it impossible to pay for goods or even cover the minimum operating costs needed to maintain the stores, facing a critical situation." In response, the Homeplus branch of the Mart Industry Union issued a statement that day criticizing that "the company announced the decision of temporary closure for all stores without even a single word of notice to the union or employees." According to the union's account, union members who had reported to work normally that morning realized the stores were closed, and the union only later received an official document about the temporary closure from the company after requesting a fact check. (홈플러스는 이날 휴업 발표를 두고 “운영자금이 완전히 고갈돼 상품 대금 지급은 물론 매장 유지를 위한 최소한의 운영비조차 감당할 수 없는 한계 상황에 직면했기 때문”이라고 밝혔다. 이에 민주노총 서비스연맹 마트산업노조 홈플러스지부는 이날 성명을 내어 “전 매장 임시 휴업이라는 결정을 (회사는) 노조와 직원에게 단 한마디 공지도 없이 통보했다”고 비판했다. 노조 설명을 종합하면, 이날 오전에 정상 출근한 현장 조합원들은 점포가 문을 닫은 사실을 인지했고, 노조가 이후 회사에 사실관계 확인을 요청한 뒤에야 회사로부터 임시 휴업 관련 공문을 전달받았다고 한다.)

The Mart Industry Union urged the government to devise countermeasures, arguing that the major shareholder, MBK Partners, has neither the will nor the qualifications to normalize Homeplus. This is because, combining mart workers, tenant business owners, and partner subcontracting companies, the livelihoods of hundreds of thousands of people are at stake. The union raised its voice, saying, "This situation goes beyond a simple corporate business issue; it is a livelihood collapse and social disaster caused by predatory speculative capital. The Yoon administration must recognize the severity of the situation." The union plans to hold a rally condemning MBK Partners on the 15th, and starting from the 16th, it will continue candlelight protests every evening in front of the Presidential Office. (마트산업노조는 대주주인 엠비케이(MBK)파트너스가 홈플러스를 정상화할 의지도, 자격도 없다며 정부에 대책 마련을 촉구했다. 마트 노동자와 입점 업주, 협력 외주업체 등까지 합하면 수십만명의 생계가 달려 있다는 이유에서다. 마트산업노조는 “이 사태는 단순히 기업의 영업 문제를 넘어 약탈적 투기자본에 의한 민생 파탄이자 사회적 재난”이라며 “이재명 정부는 사태의 심각성을 인지하라”고 목소리를 높였다. 노조는 오는 15일에 엠비케이파트너스 규탄 집회를 한 뒤, 16일부터는 매일 저녁 청와대 앞에서 촛불 투쟁을 이어갈 예정이다.)

Earlier, on the 3rd, the Seoul Bankruptcy Court decided to terminate the rehabilitation proceedings for Homeplus. If Homeplus fails to secure a financing plan worth 200 billion won by the 20th, the court's decision will be finalized. In an official letter sent to the union on this day, Homeplus said, "We earnestly requested another loan of 200 billion won in operating funds from the Meritz Financial Group (the largest creditor), but it has not yet been accepted. Whether to resume operations of large supermarkets will be determined after the court's final decision on the 20th." However, industry insiders interpret this as Homeplus essentially heading toward bankruptcy. (앞서 서울회생법원은 지난 3일 홈플러스 회생절차 폐지를 결정했다. 오는 20일까지 2천억원 규모의 자금 조달 방안을 마련하지 못하면 법원의 결정은 확정된다. 홈플러스는 이날 노조에 보낸 공문에서 “(최대 채권자인) 메리츠금융그룹 쪽에 다시 한 번 2천억원의 운영자금 대출을 간절히 요청했으나 아직 수용하지 않고 있는 상황”이라며 “대형마트 영업 재개 여부는 20일 법원의 최종 결정을 지켜보고 결정할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 하지만 업계에서는 홈플러스가 사실상 파산 수순에 이르렀다는 풀이가 나온다.)

Reporters: Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr, Kim Hye-yoon unique@hani.co.kr, Jeong In-seon ren@hani.co.kr, Park Da-hae doall@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr, 김혜윤 기자 unique@hani.co.kr, 정인선 기자 ren@hani.co.kr, 박다해 기자 doall@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Top Priority Investment in Three Mega-Projects… Aiming to Create 300,000 Youth Jobs (3대 메가프로젝트 최우선 투입…청년 일자리 30만개 만든다)
item.description:
The government's decision at the National Fiscal Strategy Meeting on the 13th to increase total spending next year by more than 10% from this year, budgeting over 800 trillion won—the largest ever—reflects its intent to view an unprecedented tax revenue boom as a "golden time" for future generations and to pursue aggressive investment. The government announced it would focus the increased resources on future growth industries such as the three mega-projects (semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI), while also establishing a "Future Response Fund" to invest in the younger generation and local regions. (정부가 13일 국가재정전략회의에서 내년도 총지출을 올해보다 10% 이상 늘려 역대 최대 규모인 800조원 이상 편성하기로 한 것은 유례없는 세수 호황이 미래 세대를 위한 ‘골든 타임’이라고 보고 적극적인 투자를 감행하겠다는 취지다. 정부는 늘어난 재원을 3대 메가프로젝트(반도체, 인공지능 데이터센터, 피지컬 에이아이) 등 미래 먹거리 산업에 집중적으로 투입하는 한편, ‘미래대응기금’을 신설해 청년 세대와 지방 등에도 투자하겠다고 밝혔다.)

This marks the first time since 2009 (10.6%) that the total expenditure growth rate has exceeded 10% based on the main budget. Unlike the fiscal expansion during the global financial crisis at that time, this move reflects a determination to play an active fiscal role amid a major industrial transition, backed by a semiconductor tax revenue boom. (본예산 기준 총지출 증가율이 10%를 넘기는 건 2009년(10.6%) 이후 처음이다. 당시 글로벌 금융위기 대응을 위해 재정 지출을 확대했던 것과 달리, 이번엔 반도체 세수 호황을 바탕으로 산업 대전환기에 재정의 적극적 역할을 하겠다는 의지가 담겨 있다.)

The reason such an increase in total spending is possible is that an unprecedented scale of tax revenue is expected due to the semiconductor industry's super-boom. Budget Minister Park Hong-keun predicted national tax revenue next year would exceed 500 trillion won—a record high—which is over 100 trillion won more than this year's main budget of 390.2 trillion won. Additionally, Minister Park stated, "By combining the increased tax revenue with drastic expenditure restructuring, we will achieve twice the previous year's level of spending cuts, around 50 trillion won," and mentioned that reforms to the local education fiscal grant, which automatically allocates 20.79% of domestic tax revenue, and the basic pension, uniformly paid to seniors in the bottom 70% of income, would also be pursued to secure funds. (이런 총지출 증가가 가능한 이유는 반도체 산업 초호황으로 역대 최대 규모의 세수가 걷힐 것으로 예상되기 때문이다. 박홍근 기획예산처 장관은 내년 국세수입이 사상 최대치인 500조원 이상 될 것으로 예상했는데, 올해 본예산 기준 국세수입(390조2천억원)보다 100조원 이상 많다. 아울러 박 장관은 “늘어난 세수에 뼈를 깎는 지출구조조정을 더해 전년의 두배인 50조원 수준의 지출구조조정을 달성하겠다”며 내국세 총액의 20.79%가 자동으로 배정되는 지방교육재정교부금 개편, 소득 하위 70% 어르신에게 동일하게 지급되는 기초연금 개편 등도 함께 추진해 재원을 마련하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The government outlined four key investment directions: △ Shifting the growth paradigm centered on three mega-projects, △ Local-led growth through infrastructure and K-culture, △ Improving structural polarization for youth, startups, and small business owners, and △ Building a foundation for national safety and peace through self-defense and pragmatic diplomacy. (정부는 4대 중점투자 방향으로 △3대 메가프로젝트 중심으로 성장 패러다임 전환 △인프라·케이(K)-컬처 등을 통한 지방주도 성장 △청년·스타트업·소상공인 등 양극화 구조 개선 △자주국방·실용외교 등 국민 안전과 평화 기반 구축을 제시했다.)

Alongside this, a Future Response Fund will be established to utilize the large increase in tax revenue. Additional tax revenue exceeding long-term trends will be accumulated in the fund and invested in four areas: youth, growth engines, local regions, and talent. (이와 함께 대규모 세수 증가분을 활용하기 위한 미래대응기금도 신설된다. 장기 추세를 넘어서는 추가 세수를 기금에 적립해 청년·성장동력·지방·인재 4대 분야에 투자하는 용도다.)

The government also stated for the first time on this day that the nature of the Future Response Fund is "a fiscal stabilization device to mitigate tax revenue volatility." When tax revenue shortfalls or supplementary budgets are needed due to changing economic conditions, the fund's surplus can be used to bolster fiscal capacity in a timely manner. (정부는 이날 미래대응기금의 성격을 두고 “세수 변동성을 완화하는 재정 안정화 장치”라는 점도 처음 밝혔다. 경제 상황 변화로 세수 결손 및 추가경정예산(추경) 등이 필요할 때, 기금의 여유 자금을 활용해 재정 여력을 적기에 보강할 수 있다는 것이다.)

However, considering the government's broad allocation of the fund's use to areas like the younger generation, growth engines, and local investment, it may end up being used with few restrictions. Inha University Professor Kang Byung-gu (Economics) noted, "While promoting innovation during the AI transition is important, income and asset gaps are bound to widen," adding, "The fund must also be sufficiently invested in social and employment safety nets for those who fail to transition, like low-skilled workers, to make innovation sustainable." (다만 정부가 기금의 활용처를 청년 세대 및 성장동력, 지방 투자 등 폭넓게 잡아둔 점을 고려하면 특별히 용처에 구애받지 않고 쓰게 될 수도 있다. 강병구 인하대 교수(경제학)는 “인공지능 대전환기에 혁신 촉진도 중요하지만, 소득과 자산 격차는 커질 수밖에 없다”며 “저숙련 노동자 등 전환에 실패하는 계층을 위한 사회·고용 안전망에도 기금을 충분히 투자해야 혁신도 지속가능하다”고 말했다.)

Regarding concerns about rising national debt, Minister Park added, "From 2027 onward, both the fiscal balance and national debt will clearly improve," and "The national debt-to-GDP ratio will be managed lower than the 2029 target (58.0%) by 2030. Through this, we aim to end wasteful fiscal debates and achieve the highest-ever level of national creditworthiness." (일각에서 제기되는 국가채무 증가 우려에 대해선 박 장관은 “2027년부터 재정수지와 국가채무 모두 뚜렷하게 개선될 것”이라며 “국내총생산 대비 국가채무비율은 2030년에 2029년 목표치(58.0%)보다도 낮게 관리하겠다. 이를 통해 소모적 재정 논쟁을 종식하고 역대 최고 수준의 국가 신인도를 달성하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

On the same day, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol announced a plan for intensive youth support. By 2030, the goal is to train 200,000 young professionals with future capabilities like AI, and create over 300,000 jobs—including 200,000 in the private and public sectors and 100,000 young entrepreneurs. In housing, new types of public rental housing will be sufficiently provided to youth, and burdens like rent will be eased. To support youth asset building, a youth-type Individual Savings Account (ISA) with expanded benefits will be launched, and for newlyweds, income criteria for housing loans will be temporarily eased to eliminate the "marriage penalty" so that conditions before and after marriage remain similar. Cultural support, such as expanding the youth culture and arts pass, will also be strengthened. (이날 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 청년 집중 지원 방안을 발표했다. 2030년까지 인공지능 등 미래 역량을 갖춘 청년 전문인력 20만명을 양성하고, 민간부문·공공부문 일자리 20만개와 청년 창업가 10만명 등 30만개 이상의 일자리를 창출하겠다고 했다. 주거 분야에서는 신유형 공공임대주택을 청년에게 충분히 공급하고, 임차료 등 부담을 덜겠다고 했다. 청년 자산 형성을 위해 혜택을 확대한 청년형 개인종합자산관리계좌(ISA)를 출시하고, 신혼부부 주택자금 대출 때 소득 기준을 한시 완화해 결혼 전후로 차이가 나지 않도록 ‘결혼 페널티’도 해소하겠다고 밝혔다. 청년문화예술패스 확대 등 문화 지원도 강화한다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr Reporter Park Soo-ji suji@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr 박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Even After Abolition of 'CEO Joint Guarantee,' Over 4 Trillion Won in Claims Blocking Second Chances Remain (‘대표이사 연대보증’ 폐지됐어도 패자부활 막는 채권 4조 남았다)
item.description:
Although the joint guarantee system for CEOs of public institutions was abolished eight years ago, over 4 trillion won in recourse and special claims stemming from past joint guarantees still remain. Critics argue that long-term claims with low recovery value should be actively reduced and cleared to support entrepreneurs in making a comeback. (8년 전 공공기관의 대표이사 연대보증 제도가 폐지됐지만 과거 연대보증에서 비롯된 구상·특수채권이 여전히 4조원 넘게 남아 있는 것으로 나타났다. 회수 실익이 낮은 장기 채권을 적극적으로 감면·정리해 기업인의 재기를 지원해야 한다는 지적이 나온다.)

On the 13th, according to data compiled by the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Lee In-young from various agencies and documents obtained by *The Hankyoreh* through information disclosure requests, as of the end of May this year, the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund, Korea Technology Finance Corporation, Regional Credit Guarantee Foundations, and Korea SMEs and Startups Agency held a total of 4.1777 trillion won (32,559 cases) in recourse and special claims related to CEO joint guarantees. ( 13일 이인영 더불어민주당 의원실이 각 기관에서 받은 자료와 한겨레가 정보공개청구를 통해 확보한 자료를 종합하면, 올해 5월 말 기준 신용보증기금·기술보증기금·지역신용보증재단·중소벤처기업진흥공단이 보유한 대표이사 연대보증 관련 구상·특수채권은 모두 4조1777억원(3만2559건)에 이른다.)

The CEO joint guarantee system required CEOs to personally assume debt obligations when small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) took out loans or guarantees, in case the company failed to repay. Following criticism that a single business failure saddled entrepreneurs with excessive debt, making even re-founding a business difficult, the government abolished joint guarantees for corporate representatives at the four agencies in April 2018. It was decided not to require joint guarantees for new or increased loans and guarantees, and to phase out existing loans and guarantees over five years. <<> However, claims that had already turned into non-performing loans at the time of abolition, or debts remaining as CEO obligations due to company insolvency during the phased removal of existing joint guarantees, were excluded from the abolition scope. As a result, past joint guarantee debts continue to lead to wage garnishments, asset seizures, and credit information registrations, hindering entrepreneurs from restarting their businesses. <<> Among the total claims, special claims amounted to 3.093 trillion won (22,709 cases), and recourse claims totaled 1.0847 trillion won (9,850 cases). Recourse claims are those where a guarantee agency repays a bank on behalf of a debtor company and then demands reimbursement from the company and joint guarantors, while special claims are those that have been written off in accounting due to low recovery prospects but retain legal rights. <<> By institution, the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund, which has historically handled the largest share of public guarantees, had the most, with special claims of 1.7962 trillion won and recourse claims of 674.8 billion won. The Korea Technology Finance Corporation had 831.2 billion won and 287.5 billion won, respectively, while the Regional Credit Guarantee Foundations had 248.6 billion won and 122.4 billion won. The Korea SMEs and Startups Agency held 217 billion won in special claims but no recourse claims. <<> One debtor who had provided a CEO joint guarantee for a company's debts through a guarantee agency in 2011 before the company closed in 2012 said, "The bank debt was settled at around 30% of the principal, but the public agency said debt reduction was impossible because the company I now operate is in the same industry as the one that closed," adding, "My salary is still subject to garnishment." <<> The guarantee agencies maintain that they have waived a significant portion of existing joint guarantees and cleared non-performing claims through methods such as reduction, suspension of collection, sale, or cancellation. However, given that even already written-off special claims remain outstanding for long periods, there are calls for more proactive resolution. Lawmaker Lee In-young stated, "The Financial Services Commission and public agencies should quickly develop concrete measures to reduce long-term recourse and special claims, lowering the barriers to re-challenge." <<> Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr ( 대표이사 연대보증은 중소기업이 대출이나 보증을 받을 때 기업이 빚을 갚지 못할 경우에 대비해 대표이사가 개인적으로 채무를 부담하도록 하는 제도다. 한 번의 사업 실패로 기업인은 과도한 빚을 떠안고 재창업마저 어려워진다는 비판이 이어지자, 정부는 2018년 4월에 4개 기관의 법인 대표자 연대보증을 폐지했다. 신규·증액 대출과 보증에는 연대보증을 요구하지 않고, 기존 대출·보증도 5년에 걸쳐 단계적으로 해제하기로 했다.)

item.title: Time Is What Young People Lack the Most… Let's Give It Back Through Basic Income (청년들 가장 부족한 자원은 ‘시간’…기본소득으로 돌려주자)
item.description:
<<>> As the Lee Jae-myung administration enters its second year, discussions on basic income are resurfacing. A pilot project for basic income in farming and fishing villages is already underway, and the next item on the agenda appears to be youth basic income. While I remain cautious about a full-scale introduction of basic income due to fiscal feasibility, I believe a limited, modified form of basic income for young people—more precisely, cash payments—as a pilot project is worth attempting. However, the design process must start from the results and lessons left by similar experiments conducted so far. <<> First, let's examine the logic that sees basic income as a solution to the "welfare trap." In Western welfare states, once people enter the labor market and earn income, their existing welfare benefits are cut, driving up the effective tax rate. Under the calculation that working leads to losses, people become reluctant to work at all. The argument is that basic income, which doesn't reduce benefits even when one gets a job, could boost job-seeking incentives and thus resolve this trap. However, Finland's basic income experiment—the world's first national-level trial—showed this prediction was off. The difference in working days between basic income recipients and unemployment benefit recipients was negligible. While the initial expectation was that working hours would increase by at least 20–50%, the actual increase was 0% in the first year and only 8% in the second year. Of course, the opposite fear also proved unfounded: no significant labor market withdrawal was observed among basic income recipients. Similar results came from Sam Altman, the creator of ChatGPT, who ran a three-year experiment giving low-income households in Texas and Illinois $1,000 monthly with no strings attached, and from a German experiment targeting the middle and lower classes. While outcomes vary slightly depending on payment conditions and amounts, there was no worrisome reduction in working hours. In short, basic income up to a certain level does not significantly affect labor supply. Neither the fear of "encouraging laziness" nor the hope of "solving the welfare trap" aligns with the reality shown by data. <<> Another argument is justifying youth basic income as a precaution against AI-driven mass unemployment. Of course, the spread of large language model (LLM) services has turned the fear of a "job apocalypse" into a reality that must be seriously considered. This is a different situation from when basic income was first discussed in Korean society. However, even if an AI-driven seismic shift occurs, the generation likely to face the brunt of the impact is the 30s and 40s, who are at the heart of the labor market. Consequently, those in their early 20s, who haven't yet entered or are just at the threshold, would inevitably be a lower priority. Therefore, technological unemployment does not seem sufficient as a direct and primary justification for youth basic income. <<> The Overlooked Deficiency: Youth's Time <<> So, what should be the basis for youth basic income? As a professor at a local university, what I've learned from counseling students is that the most crucial resource they lack is time. Over the past 20 years, tuition freezes and the expansion of national scholarships have significantly reduced the burden of tuition fees. However, since most public and private scholarships prohibit overlapping receipt, a situation arises where "scholarships are abundant, but living expenses are scarce." This could be resolved if administrative flexibility were allowed, but signs of improvement are rare. Consequently, many students take on part-time jobs to cover living costs. Students prefer on-campus or nearby jobs for efficient time use, with convenience store gigs being typical. But there's fierce competition, and some store owners, aware of this, pay these students below the statutory minimum wage (surprisingly, this phenomenon is easily observed even near Kyungpook National University, where I work. And even more surprisingly, some politicians who should be correcting this argue for legislating differentiated minimum wages in Daegu). To earn a higher hourly wage, students must seek jobs elsewhere, incurring time costs for commuting. Eventually, some even take a break from their studies for part-time work. <<> Paradoxically, though the students themselves may not fully realize it, time is especially important during the student phase. This time could have originally been used for study, self-development, career exploration, or leisure. Students in need of living expenses are often from low-income households, and they try to solve this problem by selling their most liquid asset—time—in the market. What's the result? Behavioral economist Sendhil Mullainathan of MIT, in his book *Scarcity: Why Having Too Little Means So Much*, called one of the anticipated negative outcomes "tunneling." People feeling pressed focus narrowly on urgent immediate matters, while important long-term choices are pushed out of sight. Just as those pressed for money turn to high-interest loans, youth pressed for time become trapped in this week's part-time schedule, losing the leeway to design their own futures. Scarcity depletes decision-making ability, and depleted decision-making reproduces scarcity. This significantly impacts their entry into the labor market and their early achievements. <<> In this sense, time inequality must be treated as seriously as income and asset inequality. Time is the most equitable asset, given as 24 hours a day to Samsung Group Chairman Lee Jae-yong, to me, and to my students. But the freedom to use that time as one wishes is not distributed fairly. Some, thanks to their parents' income and luck, enjoy all 24 hours fully, while others must carve out three or four of those hours to sell in the market. This is precisely where the legitimacy of a youth basic income pilot lies. It's not about work incentives or preparing for technological unemployment, but about the "redistribution of time" during the life stage of youth. <<> If an Unconditional 330,000 Won Per Month Is Given to Young People in Their Early 20s in Local Regions <<> So, what amount would be appropriate? It's hard to say there's a definitive answer. But as a starting point for discussion, we might consider around 330,000 won per month, or about 4 million won annually. Converted to an hourly wage of 10,000 to 15,000 won, this would effectively return 20 to 33 hours per month. According to one statistic, enrolled or on-leave university students work about 19.4 hours per week, or roughly 78 hours per month. A youth income like this would help return about a week's worth of their labor time back to them. <<> Additionally, designing it at a lower level than conditional benefits of current programs, such as the job-seeking promotion allowance (600,000 won per month), seems desirable in terms of consistency with existing systems and social acceptance. Instead, conditions should be minimized. I suggest eliminating administrative barriers like income and asset screenings or restrictions on overlapping with other support, and attaching no conditions other than cooperating with basic information collection for performance evaluation. This aligns with the principle of basic income and the original aim of this policy. Leaving it up to the youth to decide how to use the recovered time seems more faithful to the policy's intent. <<> As for the pilot region, I suggest considering local areas rather than the capital region, preferably small cities below the Chungcheong region. This is because the density of perceived time poverty differs. Young people in the capital and Chungcheong regions have relatively robust labor markets, but local youth are more likely to have to sell more time to earn the same money. Since it's a youth-targeted project, a city with a significant youth population would be suitable. A small-to-medium-sized city with humanities high schools, specialized high schools, vocational colleges, and a four-year flagship university would allow simultaneous observation of three paths: high school graduate employment, vocational college enrollment, and university enrollment. Cities roughly meeting these conditions exist in Daegu-Gyeongbuk, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam, Honam, and Gangwon. Choosing the optimal city requires professional judgment from policymakers, which is beyond the scope of this article, but if pressed, I'd suggest Gangneung, Andong, or Suncheon. <<> Focusing the age range on early 20s seems reasonable. The basis is flexibility. By the late 20s, employment and childcare fill much of the day with fixed time. Even if an opportunity to trade time for money arises, the already rigid life framework makes it hard to convert the policy-granted time into actual free time. In contrast, time in the early 20s is relatively flexible. The time capital given during this period is more likely to flow where the youth wants and change their life. From an economist's perspective, the marginal benefit of time is considered greater in the early 20s. <<> Performance indicators are very simple. Compare how time allocation changed between youth who received the benefit and those who didn't. Check whether part-time hours decreased, whether time for study and self-development increased, and what they did with that time. Although the design differs, the Seoul Metropolitan Government's youth allowance is known to have undertaken similar work, so it would be a good comparison. <<> Money can appear even when it's gone, but time, once lost, never returns. A year at age 20 is not the same as a year at age 40. This is because time during that period is the last liquid asset that can be used for exploring careers, failing, and changing direction. Above all, it's almost the only time in life when failure is permissible. If the government wants to give something to young people, it should start with the most precious and irreplaceable resource. Let's give time back to young people. <<> Choi Han-soo, Professor at Kyungpook National University ()

item.title: Foundation Myeongmun Donates 14 Million Won to SeoulTech as 'SeoulTech Love Development Fund' (재단법인 명문, 서울과기대에 ‘SeoulTech 사랑의 발전기금’ 1,400만 원 기탁)
item.description:
Seoul National University of Science and Technology (President Kim Dong-hwan, hereinafter SeoulTech) held a 'SeoulTech Love Development Fund Delivery and Scholarship Certificate Award Ceremony' on Friday, July 10, at 3 PM, in the roundtable conference room of the university's main building. (서울과학기술대학교(총장 김동환, 이하 서울과기대)는 7월 10일(금) 오후 3시 교내 대학본부 원탁회의실에서 ‘SeoulTech 사랑의 발전기금 전달 및 장학증서 수여식’을 개최했다.)

The event was attended by SeoulTech President Kim Dong-hwan, Foundation Myeongmun Secretary General Jo Yoon-seong, and SeoulTech's Director of External Affairs Hwang Bo-bong, among others. (이날 행사에는 김동환 서울과기대 총장과 재단법인 명문 조윤성 사무국장을 비롯해 황보봉 서울과기대 대외협력처장 등이 참석했다.)

Since its establishment in 2024, Foundation Myeongmun has been discovering talented individuals with excellent potential and students with outstanding academic achievements despite difficult family circumstances, providing support for tuition, scholarships, and living expenses to enable them to focus on their studies in a stable environment. (재단법인 명문은 2024년 설립 이래 우수한 재능과 잠재력을 지닌 인재와 어려운 가정 형편 속에서도 학업 성취도가 뛰어난 학생을 발굴해, 안정적인 환경에서 학업에 전념할 수 있도록 학비와 장학금, 생활비 등을 지원해 오고 있다.)

Foundation Myeongmun donated 14 million won in scholarship funds to support the studies of SeoulTech students in the mechanical and automotive fields and to contribute to the cultivation of excellent talent. (재단법인 명문은 서울과기대 기계·자동차 계열 재학생의 학업을 지원하고 우수 인재 양성에 기여하기 위해 장학기금 1,400만 원을 기탁했다.)

SeoulTech President Kim Dong-hwan said, "I am truly grateful for the donation of this precious scholarship again this year, following last year," adding, "We will deeply cherish the intent of Foundation Myeongmun and do our utmost to cultivate outstanding talent that can contribute to the development of the country and society." He continued, "I look forward to continued growth through ongoing exchange and cooperation between Foundation Myeongmun and SeoulTech in the future," expressing his gratitude. (김동환 서울과기대 총장은 “지난해에 이어 올해도 소중한 장학금을 기탁해 주셔서 진심으로 감사드린다”며 “재단법인 명문의 뜻을 깊이 새겨 국가와 사회 발전에 이바지할 수 있는 우수 인재를 양성하는 데 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다. 이어 “앞으로도 재단법인 명문과 서울과기대가 지속적인 교류와 협력을 통해 함께 성장할 수 있기를 기대한다”고 감사의 뜻을 전했다.)

Foundation Myeongmun Secretary General Jo Yoon-seong stated, "I am delighted to continue our valuable relationship with Seoul National University of Science and Technology this year as well," and said, "We will persistently support the science and engineering talents who will lead the future industries of our country, enabling them to pursue their dreams in a stable environment." (조윤성 재단법인 명문 사무국장은 “서울과학기술대학교와의 소중한 인연을 올해도 이어갈 수 있어 기쁘다”며 “우리나라 미래 산업을 이끌어 갈 이공계 인재들이 안정적인 환경에서 꿈을 펼칠 수 있도록 지속적으로 응원하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies English Division Successfully Completes Short-Term Language Program at the University of Guam (사이버한국외국어대학교 영어학부, 美 괌 대학교서 단기어학연수 성료)
item.description:
Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (hereinafter CUFS, President Moon Hwi-chang) successfully completed the 2026 Summer Short-Term Language Program for the English Division at the University of Guam, held from Sunday, June 28, to Saturday, July 4. (사이버한국외국어대학교(이하 사이버한국외대, 총장 문휘창)는 6월 28일(일)부터 7월 4일(토)까지 미국 괌 대학교에서 2026년 영어학부 하계 단기어학연수를 성료했다.)

CUFS organizes overseas short-term language programs during the break to enhance students' foreign language proficiency and global awareness. The English Division has annually provided short-term language opportunities in English-speaking countries such as the United States, Ireland, and Singapore, and the program at the University of Guam was held for the second time, following last year's session. (사이버한국외대는 학생들의 외국어 활용 능력과 국제 감각을 함양하기 위해 방학 기간을 활용해 해외 단기어학연수 프로그램을 마련하고 있다. 영어학부는 미국, 아일랜드, 싱가포르 등 영어를 사용하는 국가에서 매해 단기어학연수의 기회를 제공해왔으며, 괌 대학교에서의 연수는 지난해에 이어 두 번째로 진행됐다.)

This year's program, led by Professor Hong Ji-ye of CUFS's English Division, included 25 undergraduate and graduate students. Considering that most participants were working professionals, Professor Hong carefully coordinated with the University of Guam to design a schedule that balanced intensive, efficient English conversation practice with diverse cultural experiences. The group participated in discussion and conversation-focused language classes, as well as activities exploring Guam's culture, thereby enhancing their language skills and global competence. (이번 연수는 사이버한국외대 영어학부 홍지예 교수의 인솔하에 학부생 및 대학원생 25명이 참가했다. 홍 교수는 연수 참가자의 대부분이 직장인임을 고려해 단기간 고효율 영어 회화 실습과 다양한 문화 체험이 함께 이뤄질 수 있도록 괌 대학교와의 철저한 사전 협의를 거쳐 일정을 구성했다. 연수단은 집중적인 토론 및 회화 위주의 어학 수업은 물론 괌 문화 체험을 비롯한 여러 활동에 참여하며 어학 실력과 글로벌 소양을 쌓았다.)

Park O-ho, a student from CUFS's English Division who participated in the program, shared his thoughts: "I was worried it might be hard to adapt due to my age, but it was a very rewarding time to actually use the English expressions I learned in class and experience Guam's culture." Professor Hong Ji-ye, who led the program, added, "Since we planned it through long-term communication with the University of Guam, I believe it was very successful in motivating students' English learning. We will continue to incorporate student feedback to develop the program in even more beneficial directions." (연수에 참여한 사이버한국외대 영어학부 박오호 학생은 “나이가 많아 적응하기 어려울까 걱정되었지만, 수업에서 배운 영어 표현을 실제로 써보고 괌의 문화도 체험해보는 매우 유익한 시간이었다”라고 소감을 전했다. 연수를 인솔한 홍지예 교수는 “괌 대학교와 오랜 시간 소통하여 기획한 만큼 학생들의 영어 학습에 동기부여가 된 것 같아 매우 성공적이었다고 생각한다”며, “앞으로도 학생들의 피드백을 수용하여 더욱 유익한 방향으로 연수 프로그램을 발전시켜 나갈 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

CUFS's English Division, the largest division among domestic cyber universities in terms of student enrollment, operates five specialized tracks: ▲Practical & Business English ▲TESOL ▲English Interpretation & Translation ▲Aviation & Tourism English ▲AI & English. It offers differentiated extracurricular programs such as video lectures by native-speaking professors and one-on-one phone English, along with opportunities like short-term overseas language programs and international cultural tours during breaks, allowing students to acquire both language and culture simultaneously. (사이버한국외대 영어학부는 국내 사이버대학 중 가장 많은 수의 학생이 재학하고 있는 학부로, ▲실용·비즈니스영어 ▲TESOL ▲영어통번역 ▲항공관광영어 ▲AI & English 등 5가지 세부전공을 운영하고 있다. 원어민 교수진의 화상 특강, 일대일 전화영어와 같은 차별화된 비교과 프로그램과 방학 중 단기 해외어학연수 및 해외문화탐방 등 언어와 문화를 동시에 습득할 수 있는 다양한 기회를 제공한다.)

Meanwhile, CUFS is accepting applications for new and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year until Thursday, the 16th. The university is recruiting students across 10 divisions: ▲English ▲Chinese ▲Japanese ▲Korean ▲Spanish ▲Vietnamese & Indonesian ▲Business Administration ▲Industrial Safety & Housing Management ▲Counseling Psychology ▲K-Beauty. Anyone with a high school diploma or higher can apply. Detailed admission information can be found at the Admissions Center (go.cufs.ac.kr), and individual consultations are available via phone (02-2173-2580), email (ipsi@cufs.ac.kr), and KakaoTalk (cufs). (한편 사이버한국외대는 오는 16일(목)까지 2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생을 모집한다. ▲영어학부 ▲중국어학부 ▲일본어학부 ▲한국어학부 ▲스페인어학부 ▲베트남·인도네시아학부 ▲경영학부 ▲산업안전·주택관리학부 ▲상담심리학부 ▲K뷰티학부의 10개 학부에서 학생을 모집하며 고등학교 졸업 이상의 학력 보유자라면 누구나 지원할 수 있다. 입학에 관한 자세한 사항은 입학지원센터(go.cufs.ac.kr)에서 확인하면 되며, 전화(02-2173-2580)와 이메일(ipsi@cufs.ac.kr), 카카오톡(cufs)으로 개별 상담도 가능하다.)

item.title: "K-Hanwoo Captivates Global Livestock Farmers" Hanwoo Promotion Fund Showcases Excellence of Hanwoo at Korean Society of Animal Science International Conference (“세계 축산인 사로잡은 K-한우” 한우자조금, 한국축산학회 국제학술대회서 한우 우수성 알려)
item.description:
The Hanwoo Promotion Fund Management Committee (Chairman Min Kyung-cheon, hereinafter Hanwoo Promotion Fund) participated in the '2026 Korean Society of Animal Science 70th Anniversary International Conference (KSAST 2026)' held at the Jeju International Convention Center (ICC JEJU) from the 8th to the 10th, carrying out promotional activities to highlight the value and competitiveness of the Hanwoo industry to domestic and international livestock experts and stakeholders. (한우자조금관리위원회(위원장 민경천, 이하 한우자조금)는 지난 8일부터 10일까지 제주국제컨벤션센터(ICC JEJU)에서 열린 ‘2026년 한국축산학회 70주년 국제학술대회(KSAST 2026)’에 참가해 국내외 축산 전문가와 관계자를 대상으로 한우 산업의 가치와 경쟁력을 알리는 홍보 활동을 펼쳤다.)

The Korean Society of Animal Science, founded in 1956, is a leading domestic academic society in animal science, holding annual conferences for livestock research and industry development. This international conference was organized under the theme '70 Years of Korean Livestock and the Direction and Vision of the Future Korean Livestock Industry' to review achievements over the past 70 years and explore future development directions for the livestock industry. It featured diverse programs including academic presentations, special industry sessions, and exhibitions. (한국축산학회는 1956년 창립한 국내 대표 축산 학술단체로, 축산 연구와 산업 발전을 위한 학술대회를 매년 개최하고 있다. 이번 국제학술대회는 '한국 축산 70년과 미래 한국 축산업의 방향과 비전'을 주제로 지난 70년간의 성과를 돌아보고 미래 축산업의 발전 방향을 모색하기 위해 마련됐으며, 학술 발표와 산업체 특별 세션, 전시회 등 다채로운 프로그램으로 진행됐다.)

At the opening ceremony, Chairman Min Kyung-cheon of the Hanwoo Promotion Fund Management Committee delivered a congratulatory speech for the successful hosting of the international conference and was honored with a plaque of appreciation in recognition of his contributions to the development of the Hanwoo industry. (개회식에서는 민경천 한우자조금관리위원장이 축사를 통해 국제학술대회의 성공적인 개최를 축하했으며, 한우산업 발전에 기여한 공로를 인정받아 감사패를 수상하는 영예를 안았다.)

The Hanwoo Promotion Fund operated a promotional booth at the exhibition hall for two days from July 8 to 9, promoting the excellence of Hanwoo and the value of a sustainable Hanwoo industry. The booth displayed promotional content introducing the competitiveness and sustainability of the Hanwoo industry to aid visitor understanding, and also offered participatory programs. (한우자조금은 7월 8일부터 9일까지 이틀간 전시장 내 홍보부스를 운영하며 한우의 우수성과 지속가능한 한우 산업의 가치를 알렸다. 부스에서는 한우산업의 경쟁력과 지속가능성을 소개하는 홍보 콘텐츠를 전시해 방문객들의 이해를 도왔으며, 참여형 프로그램도 함께 마련했다.)

In particular, a Hanwoo striploin grilling tasting event was organized, allowing participants to directly experience the distinct flavor and tender texture of Hanwoo. Additionally, a 'Random Capsule Draw OX Quiz' was operated to convey Hanwoo-related information in an easy and fun way, and a survey on Hanwoo awareness and satisfaction was conducted among visitors, with plans to incorporate the findings into future promotional content and strategy development. (특히 한우 채끝 구이 시식 행사를 마련해 참가자들이 한우 특유의 풍미와 부드러운 육질을 직접 체험할 수 있도록 했다. 또한 '랜덤 캡슐 뽑기 OX 퀴즈'를 운영해 한우 관련 정보를 쉽고 재미있게 전달하고, 방문객을 대상으로 한우 인식 및 만족도 설문조사를 실시해 향후 홍보 콘텐츠와 전략 수립에 반영할 계획이다.)

Chairman Min Kyung-cheon of the Hanwoo Promotion Fund Management Committee stated, "I hope this international conference serves as an opportunity to connect livestock research with the industrial field and contribute substantially to the development of farms and the overall livestock industry." He added, "The Hanwoo Promotion Fund will also continue to pursue diverse projects such as promoting consumption, stabilizing supply and demand, and strengthening the competitiveness of Hanwoo farms to strive for the sustainable development of the Hanwoo industry." (민경천 한우자조금관리위원장은 “이번 국제학술대회가 축산 연구와 산업 현장을 연결하고 농가와 축산업 전반의 발전에 실질적으로 기여하는 계기가 되길 바란다”며 “한우자조금도 소비촉진과 수급 안정, 한우농가 경쟁력 강화 등 ​다각적인 사업을 지속적으로 추진해 한우 산업의 지속가능한 발전에 힘쓰겠다”고 밝혔다.)
